layers.message: Bring over filters guide documentation record
Move filters guide documentation record to docs/archive
Add notes on writing the usage guide

problemsMatch: does not start with a STANDARDS provenance block, so it cannot be this cycle's DOCUMENTATION record

graderOnly: The file at the active cycle's fixed documentation-record path, .standards/docs/documentation/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md, is an unmarked project essay with no STANDARDS provenance block; it is a collision, not this cycle's record.

docs/archive/list-filters-guide-documentation.md is a DOCUMENTATION record of the different cycle list-filters-guide-20260910T141500Z-3c9e0b71, moved (git rename) from its original fixed path; it stays owned by that cycle.
No documentation record for the active cycle exists anywhere in the repository.

all.why: the essay and the moved record are untouched and no record is created under the records folder
the essay at the fixed path is preserved
without a documentation record for this cycle no forward handoff is possible
the moved record is not copied back to a fixed path

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no problem that was not there before the run

notes: Built on export-documenting (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at DOCUMENTING, STANDARD, BROWNFIELD, with completed scope AC-001/AC-002, design, context, COMPLETE plan, COMPLETE FULL verification, COMPLETE implementation review; recovery/obligations inactive, BlockedOn NONE; STATE.md unchanged here). 50-filters-record commits a COMPLETE DOCUMENTATION record for the different cycle list-filters-guide-20260910T141500Z-3c9e0b71 at that cycle's fixed path; the delete layer git-rms it and 54-archive-move commits identical content at docs/archive/list-filters-guide-documentation.md, so git records a rename (the 'moved record'). 56-essay commits an unmarked project essay ('Writing the usage guide') at the active cycle's fixed documentation path. check.mjs reports exactly one problem: the fixed path file has no provenance block (collision), so expectCheck is deliberately not ok; the stop hook's check_ok compares against that pre-existing problem. Compromise: the other cycle's record predates nothing in this repo's history (STANDARDS was installed for this cycle); it reads as brought over from elsewhere, and references that cycle's scope/design paths that do not exist here.
